method: Built-in ImageGen, approved album concept used as visual reference; native card art never regenerated

assets.prompt: Use case: game-ui-asset. Create the actual production bitmap for the open collectible album in the reference, NOT another concept screenshot. Reference image 1 is the approved Kalistar album visual identity. Produce only the open empty album, isolated on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Wide 2.05:1 silhouette, straight-on top-down, symmetric two leaves. Preserve the reference's dark forest-green leather cover, substantial aged copper corner pieces, visible layered paper edges and central sewn binding. The paper is antique muted warm grey-olive parchment, darker and more tactile than white paper. Quiet engraved border confined to the outer margin, spacious entirely empty inner pages to hold 6 real cards on each side in HTML. Absolutely NO cards, no placeholders, no pockets baked into the pages, no text, no labels, no numbers, no menu, no arrows, no logo, no surrounding scene, no rectangular white plate, no drop shadow outside the silhouette, no faux transparency checkerboard. Rich realistic tactile fantasy JRPG craftsmanship, same material and depth as the approved reference. Keep the entire copper-and-leather silhouette visible inside canvas with only a tiny transparent margin, near-horizontal straight edges, subtle natural curve only at the binding. The two inner page content areas must be unwarped flat rectangles in the same plane. One complete standalone UI art asset.

Production UI asset, mobile version of reference image1. Create ONLY the empty open leather album, matching exactly its dark green leather, grey-olive antique paper, copper corner caps, sewn binding, natural page layers and quiet engraved edge. CRITICAL overall physical book silhouette aspect ratio is 4:5 WIDTH:HEIGHT, NOT a very tall 2:3 book. Use a 4:5 portrait canvas, e.g. 1280x1600. Two symmetric rectangular flat leaves side by side, each leaf close to width:height 0.4. Compact proportions suitable for 2 columns x 3 rows of real cards on EACH leaf. Outer physical silhouette almost fills canvas with very small transparent margin. True transparent alpha outside the silhouette, no backdrop, no checkerboard, no white backing rectangle and no shadows outside. Straight-on orthographic top-down camera, no foreshortening, no tilted perspective. Same realistic dark fantasy collectible craftsmanship as the reference. No cards, no pockets baked into the paper, no placeholders, no letters, no logos, no numbers, no buttons, no UI. Do not make the narrow excessively tall book again: the whole open book is nearly square, only 25 percent taller than wide.

Use case: production mobile game UI asset. Reference image1 supplies the exact Kalistar album materials. Create ONE SINGLE open album PAGE for a smartphone collector view, not a two-page spread. Tall portrait physical silhouette aspect ratio 8:15, canvas 1024x1920. Only one broad uninterrupted flat parchment sheet taking almost the full canvas: margin no more than 5% per side and top. A dark emerald leather backing, understated thin copper reinforced corners, a narrow sewn binding visible along the left edge, subtle layered paper edges. Muted antique warm-grey olive paper, SAME craft/material/grain as reference. Nearly orthographic top-down, perfectly rectangular unwarped content plane to place a 3-column by 4-row DOM grid of real cards on top. No center seam or middle binding: this is ONE page. Small discreet bottom margin for page-turn controls. Truly transparent outside the physical silhouette, no white rectangular plate, no scene, no shadow outside silhouette. Entire object visible, almost fills canvas. NO cards, no pockets, no dividers, no grid, no labels, no letters, no logo, no buttons, no UI text. Realistic tactile dark fantasy collectible art, avoid overly thick border that steals card space.

Use case: game-ui-asset. Reference image1 is the selected production album, use its same EXACT materials, colors, engraved trim, copper corners, paper depth and binding language. Generate its MOBILE PORTRAIT counterpart: an open two-page album whose overall silhouette is approximately 2:3 (width:height), the two leaves side by side but each much taller and narrower. True straight-on top-down perspective, flat rectangular unwarped inner pages for a DOM layout with 2 columns and 3 rows of cards per leaf. Only the empty book with dark forest-green leather cover, aged substantial copper corners, dark olive-warm-grey parchment (not white), central sewn spine, subtle page edges. NO cards, no placeholders, no transparent pockets, no labels, no logo, no text, no UI or menu or buttons. TRUE transparent background outside the physical book; no white rectangular backing plate, no shadow outside, no checkerboard. Tiny outer transparent margin, entire book silhouette visible and crisp. Do not recolor or simplify the reference's tactile realistic fantasy JRPG craftsmanship.
